title: Privilege lattice resolver and runtime permission proxy
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build a policy evaluation component (privilege lattice resolver) paired with a lightweight runtime permission proxy to provide deterministic, low-latency RBAC v2 decisioning across API, serving runtime, and the Console. The lattice resolver compiles declarative role/permission graphs into an optimized lookup structure; the permission proxy enforces decisions, emits structured audit events, and coordinates SSO/SAML entitlement sync for Console/admin controls.
acceptance_criteria: Privilege lattice resolver produces stable, canonical decision IDs for any principal/resource/action triple
Local LRU cache hit decision latency p95 <= 5ms under 1k qps per proxy instance
Fallback to full evaluation takes <30ms and logs an explain trace for debugging
Permission proxy emits structured audit events (json) to audit-sink with schema v1.2 and no PII
Console calls can request decision traces and see evaluation path with sanitized inputs
SAML SSO entitlement sync updates user role assignments within 60s of identity provider change
End-to-end tests (API -> proxy -> runtime) included in nightly pipeline with synthetic workloads
implementation_notes: Resolver will accept declarative graph DSL (roles, inherits, grants, conditional expressions) and compile into a flattened lattice index for O(1) membership checks
Compile step runs in CI; artifacts are versioned and can be hot-swapped by the permission proxy
Permission proxy implemented as a sidecar filter for runtime gRPC/HTTP; Console will use an SDK shim that calls the same proxy API
Use WASM-based evaluation module to sandbox custom predicates and speed startup across Dedicated and Private deployments
Cache strategy: per-proxy LRU with TTL and a central invalidation topic (Kafka) for role updates and SAML sync events
Audit events: include decision_id, principal_id (hashed), resource, action, result, policy_version, trace_id; redact attributes flagged by privacy rules
Integrations: export to existing audit-sink (Splunk/ELK) and wire to Console's event timeline UI
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: inconsistent policy versions across proxies -> mitigation: enforce policy_version header and healthcheck endpoint that refuses requests when artifacts mismatch
Risk: increased tail latency under cold-start -> mitigation: pre-warm wasm modules and populate cache from snapshot store
Risk: SAML provider rate limits during entitlement sync -> mitigation: incremental delta sync + backoff and operator alerts
Risk: audit event volume spike -> mitigation: sampling policy for low-value events and burst buffer to avoid blocking enforcement path
qa_checklist: Unit tests for lattice compiler and predicate evaluation
Integration test: proxy rejects request when policy version absent
Performance test: benchmark proxy under 5k qps with 95th p50/p95 latency reports
Security test: fuzz predicates in WASM sandbox, verify no file/network access
End-to-end: SAML entitlement change reflected in Console within 60s
